name: Celsius
source:
It is about the main protagonist escaping from a highly advanced gang of feral synths before it's too late for him and his friend Ava, a Futanari red fox who is a fire child. Along the game you will uncover darker secrets about the world and ourselves, secrets that could be useful in escaping this wretched place or completely break your mind...

Escape, be doomed to fail, recaptured, sold off, corrupted, eaten, repurposed, taken, used and abused trying to escape to the rest of the world with your friends! Or not...

[From [url=https://cheesy-cookie-corp.itch.io/celsius]Itch.io[/url]]
